description: Defines base classes and templates for testing HTTP/2 payload decoders in the quiche project, including methods for starting, resuming, and validating payload decoding, as well as handling padding and frame size errors.

classes.name: PayloadDecoderBaseTest
classes.description: Base class for testing payload decoders, providing interface methods for starting, resuming, and preparing decoders, as well as managing frame headers and decoding counters.

classes.name: AbstractPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Template class for testing specific payload decoders, managing decoder setup, flags, and validation of payload decoding including error detection.

classes.name: AbstractPaddablePayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Template class for testing payload decoders with padding support, parameterized by total padding length, including padding error detection.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Final method to start decoding payload, calls the decoder’s StartDecodingPayload.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Final method to resume decoding payload, calls the decoder’s ResumeDecodingPayload.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes a payload in multiple partitionings and validates the decoded frame parts against expected.

methods.name: VerifyDetectsFrameSizeError
methods.description: Validates that decoding detects a frame size error for given payload and header.

methods.name: VerifyDetectsPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Checks that decoding detects padding length errors.
